text:
luke (All-hands host): thanks for the great Q&A today. quick live follow-up: paste a single anonymized sentence about a recent win or loss and one immediate fix we can ship in ~2 weeks. no long threads please.

maya (VP Sales): loss example: large healthcare prospect paused because they required an on-prem pilot and we only had cloud timelines. immediate fix: Sales+Eng produce a one-pager "On-Prem Quickstart (pilot)" with estimated milestones.

alice (Customer Success): win example: a customer went to prod after using our templated prompts and onboarding checklist. immediate fix: CS will publish the checklist as a reusable template in the shared drive.

jorge (Product): pattern: repeated ask for clear IdP/SCIM examples and mapping guidance. immediate fix: Product to publish a SCIM mapping note for Okta, Azure AD, and OneLogin.

ravi (Eng): engineering note: some timeouts under burst are due to KV cache pressure on long-context workloads. immediate fix: enable an automatic routing fallback to a lower-seqlen-optimized variant for bursty sessions and add telemetry.

tanya (Solutions): lost demo: retailer couldn't see deterministic fallback during hallucination test in the POC. immediate fix: Solutions to create a 5-min demo script + a single-slide hallucination mitigation summary for SEs.

elena (RevOps): ops ask: please drop anonymized loss reasons into the shared folder and use the standardized "why_lost" picklist values in Salesforce so we can aggregate. i'll push the picklist update.

nina (Growth): marketing note: if anyone has a short customer quote about reliability or cost savings, drop it into the doc and i'll draft a one-pager case study.

sam (CEO): pragmatic guidance: prioritize shipping the quickstart, auth docs, and demo artifacts. i'm happy to approve small resource requests to unblock these.

luke (All-hands host): i'll collate everything into a follow-up checklist with owners and due dates and ping in 10 days. please keep your added lines to one sentence each. thanks!
file_notes: All-hands follow-up thread: concise anonymized win/loss sentences and one short actionable deliverable per person. No title field in accordance with agents.md.
